formats.key: vouchWithPermit(string target, uint256 amount, string metadata, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Signs an EIP-2612 permit that lets the Vouch contract spend amount + entry fee WHUF from the signer (try/catch: if the permit fails, an existing allowance of at least that size is used).
Pulls amount + entry fee WHUF from the signer to the Vouch contract. The fee is amount × entryFeeBps / 10000, rounded up, and burned.
Creates a new vouch position owned by the signer for `target` with balance = amount. It counts toward the signer's slashable active balance and is credited in EthosRewards.
Stores the opaque `metadata` string on the new vouch.
formats.shown: Vouch {amount} WHUF for {target} plus an entry fee of unstated size, with the permit expiry; the permit amount, fee size and metadata are not shown.

findings.title: vouchWithPermit: the entry fee and the total WHUF taken (amount + fee) are not shown as numbers.
findings.evidence: EthosVouchV2.vouchWithPermit: `uint256 fee = _entryFee(amount); uint256 required = amount + fee;` with the rate read from the entryFeeBps storage. Case 0: signer out 1.01 WHUF and permit grant 1.01 WHUF; the screen shows '1 WHUF' with 'plus entry fee'.
findings.fix: The rate is set by the admin in storage, so the descriptor cannot compute it. The wording already says a fee is added. Optionally note the 10% combined fee cap (MAX_TOTAL_FEES) in the label.

findings.title: vouchWithPermit: the label 'Amount, fee added' can read as a total that already includes the fee.
findings.evidence: descriptor field amount label 'Amount, fee added'. Case 0 reader: "'Amount, fee added: 1 WHUF' may mean 1 WHUF total including fee". Code: the vouch balance is `amount`, and the fee is charged on top (`gross = amount + fee`).
findings.fix: Label it 'Stake (entry fee charged on top)' or 'Vouch amount, before entry fee'.

findings.title: vouchWithPermit: the permit spender and the permit amount are not shown, only the expiry.
findings.evidence: vouchWithPermit calls `permit(msg.sender, address(this), required, deadline, v, r, s)`. Case 0: approval effect of 1.01 WHUF to 0x8b5e…de11. The fields show only 'Permit expires'.
findings.fix: The spender is the called contract and the allowance is used up in the same call. A label like 'Permit for amount + fee to Ethos Vouch' would help.

cases.notes: Grant of 1.01 WHUF: the reader knew a permit was signed but not its amount. Out 1.01 WHUF: the screen shows 1 WHUF plus a fee of unknown size, and the reader was unsure whether the fee was included.

formats.key: increaseVouchWithPermit(uint256 vouchId, uint256 amount, uint256 deadline, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s)
effects: Signs an EIP-2612 permit that lets the Vouch contract spend amount + entry fee WHUF from the signer.
Pulls amount + entry fee WHUF from the signer. The fee (entryFeeBps, rounded up) is burned.
Increases the signer's own vouch `vouchId` by `amount` (it reverts if the signer is not the author or the vouch is archived). This raises the slashable active balance and the rewards credit.
formats.shown: Increase vouch {vouchId} by {amount} WHUF plus an entry fee of unstated size, with the permit expiry.

findings.title: increaseVouchWithPermit: the entry fee and the total WHUF taken are not shown as numbers.
findings.evidence: EthosVouchV2.increaseVouchWithPermit: `required = amount + _entryFee(amount)`. Case 1: signer out 15.15 WHUF and permit grant 15.15 WHUF; the screen shows '15 WHUF', 'plus entry fee'.
findings.fix: The fee rate is in storage and cannot be computed. The wording already discloses the fee.

findings.title: increaseVouchWithPermit: the label 'Amount, fee added' is unclear about whether the fee is on top.
findings.evidence: descriptor amount label 'Amount, fee added'. Code `_increaseVouch`: `gross = amount + fee`, and the balance grows by `amount`.
findings.fix: Label it 'Added stake (entry fee charged on top)'.

findings.title: increaseVouchWithPermit: the vouch ID is raw and the target being vouched for is not shown.
findings.evidence: field vouchId 'Vouch ID' raw. The target hash is in storage (`vouches[vouchId].targetHash`). Case 1 reader: 'Whether you own vouch 1001803 or who it vouches for'.

cases.notes: The reader got 'about 15 WHUF, possibly slightly more' and knew a permit was signed, but did not know the 15.15 WHUF total or the permit amount.

effects: Reduces the signer's vouch `vouchId` by `amount` (gross). It reverts if the remaining balance would fall below the minimum or if the account is frozen.
Sends amount - exit fee WHUF to the signer. The exit fee (exitFeeBps, rounded up) is burned.
Lowers the signer's slashable active balance and debits their rewards credit by `amount`.
formats.shown: Withdraw {amount} WHUF from vouch {vouchId}, minus an exit fee of unstated size; the amount field is labelled 'Amount, fee deducted'.

findings.title: decreaseVouch: the label 'Amount, fee deducted' reads as the net received, but it is the gross amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor amount label 'Amount, fee deducted'. Code: `uint256 payout = amount - fee; token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, payout);`. Case 2: screen 0.6408 WHUF, signer in 0.634392 WHUF. The reader believed 0.6408 was the amount 'with the fee already deducted'.
findings.fix: Label it 'Withdraw amount (exit fee taken from it)' or 'Gross amount, before exit fee'.

findings.title: decreaseVouch: the exit fee and the net payout are not shown as numbers.
findings.evidence: `uint256 fee = _exitFee(amount);` uses the exitFeeBps storage. Case 2: 0.006408 WHUF burned, 0.634392 WHUF received.
findings.fix: The rate is in storage. The interpolated intent already says 'minus exit fee'.

cases.notes: The signer received 0.634392 WHUF. The 'fee deducted' label led the reader to take 0.6408 as the net amount received.

effects: Closes (archives) the signer's vouch `vouchId` and removes it from their active vouches. The vouch for that target ends.
Sends the whole vouch balance minus the exit fee, in WHUF, to the signer. The fee is burned.
Lowers the signer's slashable active balance and debits their rewards credit by the full balance.
formats.shown: Unvouch {vouchId}, with the exit fee deducted from the payout; neither the payout asset nor the amount is shown.

findings.title: unvouch: the screen never says the payout is in WHUF, so the reader guessed ETH.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent 'Unvouch {vouchId}, exit fee deducted from payout', with only the vouchId field. Code `_unvouch`: `token.safeTransfer(msg.sender, payout)`, where token is WHUF. Case 3: signer in 254.260908 WHUF. Reader: 'How much you get back and in what asset (likely ETH, not shown)'.
findings.fix: interpolatedIntent: 'Unvouch {vouchId}: your WHUF stake is returned, minus the exit fee'.

findings.title: unvouch: the payout amount comes from the vouch balance in storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: `uint256 balance = v.balance; uint256 payout = balance - fee;`. Case 3: 254.260908 WHUF received and 2.568292 WHUF burned. The screen shows only the vouch ID.
findings.fix: No calldata path exists. A wallet could show previewUnvouchPayout off-chain.

cases.notes: The reader expected a payout minus a fee but did not know the asset (guessed ETH) or the amount (254.26 WHUF).
